messages:
maria: Heads-up  dry run for analyst briefings tomorrow. Embargo set to 2026-04-07 09:00 PT. Who owns the fact-check doc and demo creds?

trent: I'll take fact-check doc. Need latency/cost table + sample test config.

ravi: Product wants live demos for analysts, recorded walkthrough for press post-embargo. Demo will use read-only sample data and ephemeral API keys.

julia: Legal: any % claims need test config + confidence interval. Prefer wording with "based on our internal tests."

andrew: Ops will auto-provision 48h TTL keys. Send analyst email list 24h before so we can whitelist IPs. I'll add Terraform snippet to runbook.

maria: Action items: 1) @trent post fact-check doc by 6pm PT. 2) @ravi demo script by noon tomorrow. 3) @andrew provisioning steps by 3pm. 4) @julia legal review after doc posted.

embargo-bot: Reminder: upload fact-check doc by 18:00 PT for same-day legal review.

trent: Uploaded doc with FAQ + latency table. Added analyst emails.

julia: Quick edit: use "median" not "average" in table. Approve headline variant: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token latency and cost in our test suite."

maria: Great. I'll send embargoed invites with demo key instructions after legal sign-off. Ping here for any blockers.
